name: Tan Wei Hong
bio:
Tan Wei Hong's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the Singapore Grand Prix. He was captivated by the precision and coordination required behind the scenes to orchestrate such a complex event. After graduating with a degree in logistics management, he honed his skills in supply chain optimization for a major electronics manufacturer. He transitioned to motorsport five years ago, initially working with a regional GT team before joining Proton by Premotion.

Tan's pragmatic approach is the bedrock of his success as a logistics coordinator. He meticulously plans every detail, anticipating potential roadblocks and developing contingency plans. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering commitment to ensuring that everything arrives on time and in perfect condition. He firmly believes that a well-oiled logistical machine is essential for a team's peak performance on the track.

What sets Tan apart is his creative problem-solving ability. He has a knack for finding innovative solutions to logistical challenges, from navigating complex customs regulations to optimizing transportation routes. His resourcefulness and dedication have earned him the trust and respect of the entire team, making him an invaluable asset to Proton by Premotion.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Tan is of average height, with a lean build and a focused expression.
